notes.title: Le patch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34741209/1d59a4a9a1d1d09183116c51ae1a8f416136aea9.png[/img]

Here is *finally* the awesome d'awesome patch you've all been waiting for. Took some time (because man, figuring stuff out was not easy), but here is what we managed to fix in Answer Knot.

[b]Settings-wise: A brand new settings menu! [/b]
[list]
[*] Mouse sensitivity
[*] Volume (for voice & music & effects & stuff)
[*] Y axis (for inversion if needed)
[/list]
[b]Comfort-wise:[/b]
[list]
[*] Xbox 360 controllers support is now a thing :D yay right?
[*] No more "weird walking" feeling
[/list]
[b]Good-looking-wise: [/b]
[list]
[*] No more motion blur!
[*] Improved the music toward the end. A little less "whimsical" ;)
[*] Less useless lights. Better general lighting
[*] Added a sound effect for every object you can interact with
[*] Better animation and texture for you-know-what
[/list]
[b]Tedious bugs adjusted, like: [/b]
[list]
[*] Some clipping bugs
[*] Some mesh colliders
[*] Strange / useless sound design and sound effects deleted
[*] Subtitles typos
[*] Written words typos
[*] "back" buttons are all the same now
[*] "replay" "switch on" "open" buttons now don't turn / disappear
[/list]
[b]AND BONUS: [/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new easter eggs! Now there are 33 in the game :D
[*] The puzzle everyone had trouble with has changed. More intuitive now I think.
[/list]
